# Sleep Insufficiency

**Authors:** Faiza Amin, Abdulghani Sankari

**Source:** StatPearls - StatPearls Publishing

## Abstract

Insufficient sleep is defined as a shorter duration of sleep than required to maintain daytime wakefulness. The American Academy of Sleep Medicine (AASM) and the Sleep Research Society consensus recommends a minimum of 9 hours for children 6 to 12 years of age, 8 hours for adolescents, and at least 7 hours for adults.  A sleep duration shorter than recommended for age is classified as insufficient sleep duration. This article will discuss the etiology, epidemiology, clinical manifestation, evaluation, and prognosis/complications for sleep insufficiency.
